fnol_text: My name is Anika Al-Sayed and I live at 50 Ashford Street, Clinton, NC 28387. You can reach me on (555) 745-2564 or anika.alsayed@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 3 August 2024 when the car behind, driven by Mei Jovanovic, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2024-00083. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Al-Sayed on (555) 745-2564 to acknowledge the claim. Anika confirmed the loss date as 3 August 2024.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Bianca Rasmussen gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Mei Jovanovic reports lacerations to the forearm and attended St. Brendan's Hospital. Anika reports minor burns to the hand.
